description: Outfit ideas within has already put together, for a question or an occasion in plain words: its edits ("Christmas outfits", "What to Wear to the Ballet"), its outfit pages ("Guidi outfits", "Winter outfits for women") and its looks, each a whole outfit. Up to five come back, each with its name, one line on what it is, its shopwithin.co address and the items in it that are in stock at independent luxury boutiques, with price and link. Use this when someone asks for outfit ideas, what to wear to an event or in a season, how to style a kind of item or a designer, or for Christmas outfits, winter outfits, a date night outfit or streetwear outfits. It returns only what is on within and gives no advice of its own.

department.description: Only outfits for women or only for men. Outfits made for anyone stay in.

query.description: The question or the occasion in plain words: 'christmas outfits', 'what to wear to the ballet', 'gym outfit men', 'guidi boots outfit'.
